issues.description: Header file lacks include guard (#ifndef/#define or #pragma once). This can lead to multiple inclusion errors.
issues.suggested_fix: Add #pragma once at the beginning of the file or wrap with #ifndef/#define/#endif

findings.category: ODR Violations - Static Variables in Headers

issues.description: Static const variables defined in header. Each translation unit gets its own copy, causing code bloat and potential ODR violations.
issues.suggested_fix: Use 'extern const' declaration in header and define in a single .cc file, or use constexpr with inline (C++17)

issues.description: Static const defined in header without inline specifier.
issues.suggested_fix: Add inline keyword (C++17) or move definition to .cc file

issues.description: Static const char pointer defined in header.
issues.suggested_fix: Use constexpr or move to .cc file

issues.description: Static const char array defined in header.
issues.suggested_fix: Use constexpr with inline or move definition to .cc file

issues.description: Multiple static const definitions in header file.
issues.suggested_fix: Use inline constexpr (C++17) or move definitions to .cc file

issues.description: Static const double definitions at namespace scope in header.
issues.suggested_fix: Use constexpr or inline constexpr (C++17)

issues.description: Function marked as 'static inline' - static inhibits external linkage, inline alone is preferred.
issues.suggested_fix: Use just 'inline' without 'static' for functions in headers

issues.description: Inline function defined in header with non-trivial logic.
issues.suggested_fix: Consider moving implementation to .cc file if not performance-critical

issues.description: Macro defined differently based on platform (thread_local vs __thread).
issues.suggested_fix: This is an intentional platform abstraction - no change needed

issues.description: Compiler-specific attribute macros defined conditionally for MSVC vs GCC/Clang.
issues.suggested_fix: This is an intentional platform abstraction - no change needed

issues.description: Macro expands to code in debug builds, empty in release builds.
issues.suggested_fix: This is intentional debugging infrastructure - no change needed

issues.description: Class name 'signal_t' appears in both rdb_protocol and clustering namespaces. While in different namespaces, this can cause confusion.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure these are truly distinct types or consolidate if they represent the same concept

issues.description: Class name 'store_t' appears in multiple locations.
issues.suggested_fix: Verify these are different types or consider renaming for clarity

issues.description: Class name used in multiple modules.
issues.suggested_fix: Verify types are distinct or consolidate

issues.description: Forward declaration in global namespace could cause conflicts.
issues.suggested_fix: Place forward declarations in appropriate namespace

issues.description: No 'using namespace' directives found in headers - good practice maintained.
issues.suggested_fix: N/A - no issues found

issues.description: Template implementations separated into .tcc files included at end of .hpp files. This is a valid pattern.
issues.suggested_fix: No change needed - this is an accepted pattern

issues.description: Template specializations defined in header.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure specializations are visible to all translation units that need them

issues.description: Multiple assertion styles used across the codebase: rassert(), r_sanity_check(), guarantee(), rassert_err()
issues.suggested_fix: Standardize on a consistent set of assertion macros with clear semantic differences

issues.description: Dynamic exception specifications (throw()) are deprecated in C++11 and removed in C++17.
issues.suggested_fix: Use 'noexcept' instead of 'throw()' for move to modern C++

issues.description: Multiple exception types with inheritance hierarchy. Virtual destructors present - good practice.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure all exception classes have noexcept move constructors where applicable

issues.description: No __attribute__((visibility)) or __declspec(dllexport/dllimport) attributes found. This is fine for static linking.
issues.suggested_fix: If building shared libraries, add visibility macros for public API

issues.description: Macro used consistently to disable copy constructors and assignment operators.
issues.suggested_fix: No change needed - this is good practice. Consider using =delete in modern C++

issues.description: Boost headers included in RDB protocol headers.
issues.suggested_fix: Consider if Boost dependency can be minimized or if PIMPL idiom can hide implementation details

issues.description: Forward declarations used appropriately to reduce header dependencies.
issues.suggested_fix: No change needed - good practice

issues.description: Code conditionally compiled based on NDEBUG. This can lead to ABI incompatibilities between debug/release builds.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure debug-only members don't affect object layout in release builds, or use separate debug-only types

recommendations.action: Fix missing include guard in clustering_utils_raft.hpp
Review and fix static const variables in headers to prevent ODR violations
Replace deprecated throw() with noexcept in exception classes
Standardize assertion/error handling macros across the codebase
Consider using =delete instead of DISABLE_COPYING macro for modern C++
Add visibility macros if planning to support shared library builds
